G4826I.name: Simeon
G4826I.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G4826I.brief: Prophet and teacher in the church at Antioch.
G4826I.short: Simeon, also called Niger, was a prophet and teacher in the church at Antioch who was involved in sending Paul and Barnabas on their first missionary journey.

G4826G.name: Simeon
G4826G.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G4826G.brief: Righteous and devout man who blessed Jesus in the temple.
G4826G.short: Simeon was a righteous and devout man in Jerusalem who blessed the infant Jesus in the temple and prophesied about his future.

G4826H.name: Simeon
G4826H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
G4826H.brief: An ancestor of Jesus mentioned in his genealogy.
G4826H.short: Simeon is mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus as the son of Judah and the father of Levi.
